title: 第11章 先天境修士第12章 大乾王令
slug: 太古封神第1516章直接镇压
lines: 得到命令的御兽宗弟子们立即反应了过来，迅速抽出了随身携带的兵器，组成三角攻击阵型。
林淮月面露冷意。
秦云就算实力再强，他能一个人对付得了所有御兽宗弟子？
林淮月抽出随身携带的剑，这是当初秦云送给她的，虽然不是顶级兵器，但也是精品兵器了。
今天就用它来杀秦云！
见到御兽宗的弟子冲杀过来，玄天宗年长的弟子立即吼道：“全员准备出手，誓死保护少主！”
霎时，玄天宗弟子们快速朝秦云围了过来。
“你们都给我待在原地！”
秦云取下背后的重剑，这是来的时候专门准备的一柄剑，重达百斤。
因为太大了，剑只能折叠在一起。
折叠的剑看起来不大，等秦云展开后，观望的人都惊了，这是剑吗？又宽又厚，比斩马刀还大。
秦云单手握剑。
在吞天神脉不断滋养下，秦云现在的体魄已经达到了非常强的程度，百斤重剑轻松挥动。
杀！
秦云脚踏风凌步。
气流被撕裂，背后出现了一道道残影。
观望的大长老等人顿时震住了。
极境风凌步。
秦云竟然修成了极境风凌步！
幻化出残影的秦云，手中重剑横斩过去，重达百斤的剑竟然消失了，锋利的切割声传来。
最前方的三名御兽宗弟子还没反应过来，身躯已经一分为二。
强大的力量将他们的半个身子震飞，撞在了后面来不及躲闪的御兽宗弟子身上。
一阵人仰马翻。
秦云一跃而起，真气爆发，重剑重重从高处斩落而下。
轰！
大地颤动。
御兽宗弟子被震飞了出去，惨叫声不绝于耳。
这时秦云持剑冲入御兽宗弟子之中，手中的重剑横斩而过，三角进攻阵型被狠狠地撕开了。
运气差的御兽宗弟子当场被斩杀。
运气好一些的虽然躲过了致命一击，但却是被斩断了身体一部分，当场倒在地上痛苦哀嚎。
林淮月满脸呆滞。
十九名御兽宗弟子联手，才刚和秦云接触，就已经死伤大半了。
秦云单手持着重剑奔袭而来，一剑重重斩落在地上，大地竟然被斩出了一条沟。
content_en:
After receiving the order, the disciples of the Beast Control Sect immediately reacted and quickly drew out the weapons they carried with them to form a triangle attack formation.
Lin Huaiyue looked cold.
No matter how strong Qin Yun is, can he deal with all the Beast Control Sect disciples by himself?
Lin Huaiyue took out the sword she carried with her. It was given to her by Qin Yun. Although it was not a top-notch weapon, it was still a fine weapon.
Use it to kill Qin Yun today!
Seeing the disciples of the Beast Control Sect rushing over, the older disciples of the Xuantian Sect immediately shouted: "Everyone is ready to take action and protect the young master to the death!"
In an instant, the Xuantian Sect disciples quickly surrounded Qin Yun.
"You all stay where you are!"
Qin Yun took off the heavy sword from his back. This was a sword specially prepared when he came here and weighed a hundred kilograms.
Because it was so big, the swords could only be folded together.
The folded sword didn't look big. When Qin Yun unfolded it, everyone watching was shocked. Is this a sword? It's wide and thick, bigger than a zanma sword.
Qin Yun held the sword with one hand.
Under the constant nourishment of the Heaven-Swallowing Divine Vein, Qin Yun's body has now reached a very strong level, and he can swing a hundred-jin heavy sword with ease.
kill!
Qin Yun stepped on the wind.
The air flow was torn apart, and afterimages appeared behind him.
The great elder and others who were watching were immediately shocked.
Extremely windy.
Qin Yun actually cultivated to the extreme level of Feng Lingbu!
Qin Yun, who turned into an afterimage, slashed across with the heavy sword in his hand. The sword weighing a hundred kilograms disappeared, and a sharp cutting sound was heard.
Before the three Beast Controlling Sect disciples at the front could react, their bodies had been split into two.
The powerful force knocked half of their bodies away and hit the beast-controlling sect disciples behind who had no time to dodge.
A while of people fell on their backs.
Qin Yun jumped up, his true energy exploded, and his heavy sword slashed down from a high place.
boom!
The earth trembled.
The disciples of the Beast Control Sect were blown away, and screams could not be heard.
At this time, Qin Yun rushed into the disciples of the Beast Control Sect with his sword. The heavy sword in his hand slashed across them, and the triangle attack formation was severely torn apart.
The unlucky Beast Controlling Sect disciple was beheaded on the spot.
Although the luckier ones escaped the fatal blow, part of their body was cut off and they fell to the ground on the spot, wailing in pain.
Lin Huaiyue's face was dull.
Nineteen Beast Controlling Sect disciples joined forces and just came into contact with Qin Yun, and most of them were already dead or injured.
Qin Yun rushed towards him with a heavy sword in one hand, and struck the ground with a heavy blow. A ditch was cut out of the ground.
